bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; appropriating money to the commissioner of natural resources for grants under the environment and natural resources trust fund community grant program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; ENRTF COMMUNITY GRANT PROGRAM. +]

[+$28,180,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the environment and natural resources trust fund to the commissioner of natural resources to make grants under the environment and natural resources trust fund community grant program established in Minnesota Statutes, section 116X.03. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2028. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; appropriating money to the commissioner of natural resources for grants under the environment and natural resources trust fund community grant program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; ENRTF COMMUNITY GRANT PROGRAM.

$28,180,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the environment and natural resources trust fund to the commissioner of natural resources to make grants under the environment and natural resources trust fund community grant program established in Minnesota Statutes, section 116X.03. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2028.
additions: $28,180,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the environment and natural resources trust fund to the commissioner of natural resources to make grants under the environment and natural resources trust fund community grant program established in Minnesota Statutes, section 116X.03. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2028.
